seoTitle: AI Bot Access Log Analyzer: Hits per Crawler and Path
metaDescription: Paste Apache or Nginx access log lines and count hits per AI crawler with top paths and status codes. Free, your log never leaves the browser.
intro: Counts requests from known AI crawlers in a combined-format log and shows their top paths and status codes.
why:
To decide whether to block an AI crawler, look at what it actually does on your site: how often it visits, what it fetches and whether you serve it.

Paste a log sample and see hits per crawler, distinct IPs, status codes and top paths. The log stays in your browser; remove IP addresses first if you prefer, since the tool only needs the request and user-agent. Matching is by user-agent text, which can be forged.
howTo: Paste log lines in combined format.
Check the top paths for each bot.
Decide what to allow or block.

faq.a: Combined format with referrer and user agent, common on Apache and Nginx.
Your server or firewall blocked them.

faq.q: Can a bot fake its name?
faq.a: Yes. Verify important ones with their published IP ranges.
